content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stripe alternatives

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a comprehensive solution designed to enable creators to build their own online stores without the constraints imposed by traditional payment platforms. This architecture circumvents reliance on services that exclude creators based on their geographic location. By providing a direct route to digital commerce, it empowers creators in regions like Nigeria to sell their products seamlessly while maintaining full control over their operations and revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of a combination of free and paid tools that integrate seamlessly to deliver a robust online store experience. For hosting, platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide a reliable environment. Backend logic is managed via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, while order storage is handled through Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery is facilitated by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring smooth distribution of digital products. This combination, along with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, offers a streamlined and efficient system.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where mainstream payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and other similar markets can leverage this technology to build their businesses without the fear of payment rejections or account suspensions, which can hold funds for extended periods. This approach not only enhances financial sovereignty but also provides a stable means of earning income from digital products.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your digital sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this sovereign commerce stack include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, which ensure reliable uptime. The use of Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Scripts for backend logic allows for dynamic and customizable order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets serve as data storage solutions, making it easy to manage orders and customer information. For payment processing, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee, ensuring creators can accept payments from a global audience without excessive costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce stack, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages. Next, set up the backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to process orders. Then, configure Supabase or Google Sheets for data management and integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency. Finally, upload your digital products and launch your store. For a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all essential blueprints and templates to expedite your deployment.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can still sell digital products by using sovereign commerce infrastructure. This involves utilizing free tools for hosting, backend processing, and payment acceptance, ensuring you maintain full ownership and operational control over your online store. With NOWPayments, you can easily accept cryptocurrency payments, allowing you to monetize your creations effectively.
No more account suspensions or payment rejections; you own your store.

For creators searching for alternatives to Stripe, Gumroad, or PayPal, this sovereign commerce stack offers a viable solution. Explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to gain access to all necessary blueprints and templates for establishing your digital store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

You retain full ownership and control of your data after deployment. This infrastructure ensures that you are not reliant on third-party platforms that might access or manage your information.
